title: 2021 Panini Chronicles Football Base Card #63 Josh Jacobs - Raiders NFL
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021 Panini Chronicles Football base card featuring player Josh Jacobs from the Las Vegas Raiders in the NFL. The card is part of the standard-sized set and is an original licensed reprint. It is in English and manufactured in the United States. The card number is 63 and it is from the 2021 season. It is a sports trading card with no autograph, part of the base set.
